title: WebhookTest.net
description: Anonymous webhook capture, inspection, waiting, and response configuration for AI agents.
summary: Anonymous webhook capture, inspection, waiting, and response configuration for AI agents.
offersHint: Anonymous webhook capture, inspection, waiting, and response configuration for AI agents. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://webhooktest.net/mcp

toolsPreview.name: clear_webhooks
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete every capture in a bucket. Requires confirm=true.

toolsPreview.name: configure_webhook_response
toolsPreview.description: Set the status, content type, body, safe response headers, and a delay up to 10 seconds returned by the webhook endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: create_webhook_bucket
toolsPreview.description: Create an anonymous temporary webhook capture bucket. The returned bucket ID is a bearer capability and expires after 15 days of inactivity.

toolsPreview.name: delete_webhook_bucket
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a bucket and all of its captures. Requires confirm=true.

toolsPreview.name: get_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Read one webhook capture scoped to its bucket. Sensitive headers and query values are redacted by default.

toolsPreview.name: get_webhook_bucket
toolsPreview.description: Read a bucket name and its configured HTTP response settings.

toolsPreview.name: list_webhooks
toolsPreview.description: List webhook capture summaries in newest-first order using cursor pagination.

toolsPreview.name: wait_for_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Return the latest capture, wait for a newer capture, or report received=false after the timeout.
